name: Young Adult Employment: Lifeguard and Student Recreation Aide (City of Las Cruces)
org: City of Las Cruces Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Work for the city as a lifeguard at a pool or as a student recreation aide. Lifeguards keep swimmers safe. Aides help run fun programs for the public.
who_can_apply: Lifeguards must be 16 at hire. They need lifeguard training, first aid and CPR certification before hire. The page also lists 1 year of lifeguard experience. Student recreation aides must be 16, in high school, a junior or senior, with at least a 2.0 GPA.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the program page.
duration: Part time and temporary for student aides. Hours vary. Lifeguard hours are not stated.
deadline_text: The program page does not list openings or dates. Check the city job page.
how_to_apply: Look for lifeguard and student recreation aide jobs on the city job openings page. You must show proof of age, GPA and school enrollment when hired.
notes: The page says first pick for lifeguard jobs goes to people 18 or older. Lifeguard jobs have drug and alcohol tests under city rules. The same page lists a free after school Teen Connection program for grades 6 to 12.
